ROOT_CAUSE: The first introduction pattern `\b(?:my name is|I am|I'm|This is|hey its)\s+([A-Za-zà-öø-ÿ]+(?:\s+[A-Za-zà-öø-ÿ]+){1,3})\b` matches lowercase verbs like "talking about" because it lacks capitalization constraints, and sign-off patterns missed uncapitalized or hyphenated names like "Rosa-Maria" due to restrictive character classes.
RULE: All NAME capture patterns must enforce capitalization (`[A-Z]`) on the first letter of each name token and explicitly exclude common conversational verbs.
NEXT_EDIT: Fix the NAME patterns by adding capitalization requirements to the introduction pattern and updating sign-off and relationship patterns to correctly capture hyphenated names and exclude phrases like 'talking about'.
